$description: Celebration level (Configuration Spec, Celebrations: none, subtle, full). Subtle is the design and needs no tokens here: the component tokens it reads (gamification.star.enter, gamification.badge.award-*, weekend.glow.fill, weekend.reward.*, end.glow.fill, end.tier.*) are the subtle look. `data-celebration` on the board container swaps them for these (src/styles/celebration.css). Reduced motion always wins: the global rule removes every animation and transition, and the burst is drawn only with motion allowed.

award-enter.$description: The badge award is simply there

award-shadow.$description: No glow around the badge award

glow.$description: No halo behind the week end banner or the end screen headline

tier-fill.$description: The tier word in plain text colour, no spectrum

reward-lift.$description: The chosen reward card stays in place (its border and fill still mark it)

star-enter.$description: Stars pop in from small, on the D24 scale

award-shadow.$description: A wider glow around the badge award

weekend-glow.$description: A wider halo behind the week end banner

end-glow.$description: A wider glow behind the end screen headline

reward-lift.$description: The chosen reward card rises a little more

fill.$description: A ring of light that opens out behind the stars and the badge medal (full only)

inset.$description: How far the burst reaches past its element
